blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The Police Regional Office Negros Island Region (PRO NIR) has deployed security troops and equipment on Wednesday, Oct. 14, to guarantee a safe and orderly celebration of Negros Oriental’s Buglasan Festival 2026 in Dumaguete City . The send-off ceremony took place at Camp Lt. Col. Francisco C. Fernandez Jr. in Barangay Agan-an, Sibulan town, Negros Oriental, marking the formal rollout of inter-agency security measures designed to protect residents, tourists, and festival-goers. A total of 715 personnel have been mobilized and organized into specialized task units to maintain high visibility and rapid response capabilities throughout the festivities, the PRO […]...
